profile.summary: Oakland Ice Center is an ice skating facility in downtown Oakland with two ice surfaces. It offers public skating, learn-to-skate lessons, youth and adult hockey, figure skating, curling and broomball. The rink is operated by Sharks Sports & Entertainment.
